about.meta.description.source: Live scores and match centres, a statistical forecast, the founder’s analysis and members’ predictions, kept apart, and a rating earned by predicting.

about.football.body.source: Live scores and a page for every match: the timeline, line-ups, statistics, who will miss it and each side’s form, with every competition’s table beside them. When something is missing for a match, its page says so rather than showing an empty box, and every live number says when it last changed.

about.competitions.unreachable.source: The list of competitions could not be read just now.

about.three.title.source: Three kinds of prediction, never mixed

about.three.model.body.source: A forecast computed before kick-off from the teams’ results, with the probabilities of a home win, a draw and an away win. Each version is kept as it was made, and after the match it is scored against what happened.

about.three.founder.body.source: Written and signed by a person, for selected matches.

about.three.community.body.source: Members’ own predictions. Their combined view appears once at least five members have predicted a match, beside a second one weighted only by members whose ratings are established.

about.three.apart.source: The three are shown side by side and never blended into one number.

about.rating.title.source: A rating you earn by predicting

about.rating.body.source: Predict the outcome before kick-off, with how confident you are and, if you like, the exact score; at kick-off the prediction is locked, and every version you submitted is kept. Your rating grows most from being right when it was hard to be right — how hard is the model’s own probability, fixed before kick-off — and also from exact scores, consistency, and confidence that matched the outcome.

source.one: A rating is provisional until {count} prediction has been settled.
source.other: A rating is provisional until {count} predictions have been settled.

about.rating.recompute.source: A rating can always be recomputed from the stored predictions and results alone. The {link} names the formula version in force.

about.account.source: Predicting needs an account with a verified e-mail address.

rulesPage.meta.description.source: The rules every member accepts: what FMIP is for, what is not allowed, and how leaving works.

offline.body.source: FMIP needs a connection for live scores, matches and predictions. Nothing cached is shown as current: when you are back online, the pages will load fresh.

theme.hint.source: Device follows the light or dark setting of your phone or computer. Your choice is kept in this browser and on your account, so signing in elsewhere brings it with you.

appearance.hint.source: Larger text makes every size on the page bigger. More contrast darkens secondary text and edges so all text reaches the highest readability standard. Reduced motion stops animations. Device follows the setting of your phone or computer.

appearance.guest.source: Sign in to change your profile, privacy, following and viewing territory. Your appearance choices are kept in this browser, and on your account once you sign in.

account.delete.removed.source: Deleting your account signs you out on every device and removes your e-mail address, password, display name, biography, preferences, follows, friendships, blocks, group memberships and invitations, and your push subscriptions.

account.delete.kept.source: Your messages and match panel posts stay where they were written, shown as by a deleted member. Your published community analysis is taken down. Your predictions and their settlements stay as records without your name, because other members' ratings were computed against them. Reports you made are kept for the moderation record.

account.delete.username.source: Your username is retired: nobody can register it after you. A group you own passes to its longest-standing moderator, or member; a group with nobody else in it is closed.

account.delete.confirmHint.source: Type {username} exactly as it is written here.

account.deleted.body.source: Your account was deleted and every session was signed out. Your predictions remain as records without your name.

account.export.contents.source: One file (JSON) of what this site holds about you: your account and preferences, follows, friendships, groups, every version of your predictions and how they settled, your rating history and achievements, saved stories, the messages and match panel posts you wrote, your community analysis, the reports you filed and the notifications sent to you.

account.export.refused.unavailable.source: The service is unreachable right now. No file was made.
